description: This file manages JVM object references within SparkR, including creating, validating, printing, and cleaning up Java objects (jobj). It maintains reference counts, handles garbage collection, and interacts with the JVM backend.

classes.name: jobj
classes.description: An environment-based object representing a Java object reference in SparkR, with associated id and appId.

methods.name: getJobj
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a JVM object reference with the specified object ID, updating reference count.

methods.name: jobj
methods.description: Constructs a new JVM object reference environment with a given object ID, registering a finalizer for cleanup.

methods.name: print.jobj
methods.description: Prints the type and ID of the JVM object reference.

methods.name: getClassName.jobj
methods.description: Retrieves the class name of the JVM object reference.

methods.name: cleanup.jobj
methods.description: Decrements reference count and queues the JVM object for removal if no longer referenced.

methods.name: clearJobjs
methods.description: Clears all JVM object references and removal queues.
